name: Displacement Reaction Setup (Iron in Copper Sulphate)
semanticDescription: NCERT Class 10 Chemistry Ch 1 Activity 1.9 (Fig 1.8) single displacement laboratory setup. Features an open-front hardwood test tube rack with perforated shelf, control Test Tube A containing deep blue CuSO4 solution, experimental Test Tube B containing pale green FeSO4 solution with suspended iron nail coated in reddish-brown copper deposit below liquid line, and front watch glass comparing clean vs reacted nails. Dual presentation collections: 'Displacement_Setup_Full' (complete lab bench setup) and 'Displacement_Setup_Section' (longitudinal cutaway revealing suspended nail core/copper mantle, redox electron transfer arrows Fe->Fe2+ and Cu2+->Cu, chemical equation banner Fe(s) + CuSO4(aq) -> FeSO4(aq) + Cu(s), and reactivity series badge Fe > Cu).
simplifications: Test tube rack features open front geometry to ensure 100% optical visibility of both solution columns.
Copper deposit thickness is slightly accentuated for pedagogical clarity under laboratory lighting.
Section view includes redox electron transfer vector cones and balanced stoichiometric equation banner.
